what_this_means_for_you.in_short: Res. 460 (2024): Congratulating MSU Karate Club athletes, 5th Karate Pilipinas National Championship. A commendation/recognition: the Parliament putting an achievement or a life on the official record. It carries no money or obligation, but for the honoree it is the region's formal salute - and for everyone else, a signal of what the Bangsamoro chooses to celebrate.
